label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: The only way to reach the quick add and size controls was by jumping to links whose names all start with a gendered product name; the quick view panel offered only a SHOP NOW link with no add-to-cart, so quick view gave no real shortcut.
Several controls have no accessible name or only a generic name, such as an unnamed button in the product slider and unnamed links, so I could not tell what they do.
Size buttons do not announce which size is selected; after activating UK 9 nothing was spoken, and the only sign was that the Add to Cart button changed from disabled Select A Size to enabled.

After Add to Cart the cart drawer opened with focus on Close cart but showed Cart (0) and subtotal 0 with no item, and no status message announced the item was added; only after re-reading did it show Cart (1). The cart contents are also not reached by moving focus into the drawer.

The cart drawer has two buttons both named Remove item, and the page behind the drawer stays fully readable, so the order of controls is confusing; recommended-sock controls carry raw technical names like Handle anytime-ankle-sock.
